description: Browse published devices using the same filters as the site. Price bands are in Algerian dinars (DA); unknown prices remain null. Returns 10 devices per page.

category.description: Device category. Omit to include all categories.

language.description: Language of returned page URLs and blog articles: en (default), fr or ar.

nfc.description: Only devices with NFC when true.

priceRange.description: DA price band: below 30000, 30000–59999, 60000–99999, at least 100000, or at least 200000.

q.description: Device name or brand, for example Samsung Galaxy S26.

ram.description: RAM in GB: exact 4, 6 or 8; at least 12 for the 12 option.

storage.description: Storage in GB: exact 64, 128 or 256; at least 512 for the 512 option.

name: browse_devices
